verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents its own programmatic APIs: alert ingestion, case create/update, case listing and fetching, batch case import, and filing validation and submission. API keys are managed in organization settings, so the core case workflow can be driven without the UI. However, there is no CLI, no CI integration guidance, and the developer reference is password-gated with no public spec, so headless/CI automation is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI runner/integration, public API reference or OpenAPI spec, documented non-interactive auth and automation examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
